aliases: 4MP Motorized Varifocal Bullet Solar 4G Camera Kit

power.method: 12 VDC ± 20%, 4-pin M8 waterproof connector; solar kit: 80 W photovoltaic panel + 360 Wh lithium battery

features: solar-powered wire-free — 80 W photovoltaic panel + 360 Wh (4x 90 Wh) chargeable lithium battery (C36S80 kit)
battery management: display, high/low-temperature protection, charge-discharge protection, low-battery sleep, remote wakeup
4G cellular transmission (LTE-TDD/LTE-FDD/WCDMA/GSM), Micro SIM; Wi-Fi module AP mode on Channel 11 for local setup
motorized varifocal (2.8-12mm or 8-32mm), IR supplement light up to 30m / 50m
smart supplement light, built-in eMMC/SSD storage (up to 1 TB) + microSD up to 256 GB

home_assistant.notes: Use ONVIF integration. Default ONVIF port 80.

release_notes: 4MP solar/4G motorized-varifocal bullet. Merged from two config bundles: /C36S80 (80 W solar panel + 360 Wh battery kit) and /4G (4G bullet camera, 12 VDC). Weight is the camera body only; the assembled solar-kit dimension is listed. No specific anti-corrosion protection per datasheet.
